# tests/fixtures

Owner: **Hisham with Basil permission review and owning producer**.

Shared safe fixture planning and future immutable permitted references.

| Boundary | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| Receives | Synthetic contract examples and approved tiny golden assets with provenance. |
| Produces | Future reproducible cross-module inputs with expected outputs/tolerances. |
| Consumers and dependencies | Contract/integration suites and producer/consumer debugging. |
| Never store here | Real secrets/transcripts, invalid placeholder bytes called JPEG, raw datasets or unlicensed media. |

## Directory contents

| Entry | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `README.md` | This directory guide: owner, inputs/outputs, consumers, exclusions and child-file responsibilities. |

## Future immutable fixture record

Each future shared fixture needs producer, purpose, safe ID/version, permitted use/source reference, exact input byte hash/timestamps, model/data/recipe versions, expected labels/usable/reject/neutral outcomes and numerical tolerances where appropriate. Synthetic examples can validate protocols; they do not establish sign recognition. Never commit real tokens/transcripts, placeholder base64 as a JPEG, whole datasets or restricted samples. Reviewed path-specific binary exceptions may be added later.
